title: J. A. Meyerfeldt, governor-general of Swedish Pomerania, to the King: cipher letter 143535 of Pommeranica vol. 149, read in part with the key of the time in the same volume (catalogue 451)

documents.shelfmark: Riksarkivet, Pommeranica, Skrivelser till Kungl. Maj:t från myndigheter: Generalguvernörer, vol. 149 (SE/RA/2404/I A 2/149), sample view 20261113_143535
documents.date: 15 January 1712 or 1714 ("d. 15 Januarij"; archivist's pencil "1712 el. 1714?")

plaintext.source: No gloss or decipherment of the time on the page; the key is on views 143346 and 143443 of the same volume.

transcription.source: Claude (Opus 5.5) for Brice Dudout, 24 Nov 2026, by eye on straightened copies enlarged 2-3x; k / l / m forms settled by Brice Dudout's blind sign sheet (sign_check/)
transcription.notes: Not blind: the joined forms were identified with the key while a working reading went on (NOTES.md). Blots at L1-L2, L4, L8 and in block 2. 272 cipher letters in block 1 and 54 in block 2.

system.summary: Joined script on a base line: each letter is a stroke or a loop above or below a continuous horizontal line; one form per letter; v and w share one sign; no word division.
system.notes: Key of the time in the same volume, in isolated (143443) and joined (143346) forms. The double loops k / l / m are told apart by the order and size of the two loops (sign_check/). One slanting-H sign (HP) and one small loop (XX) have no value.

prior_solution.where: The key of the time is on views 143346 and 143443 of the same volume; no decipherment of the letter is known (no gloss, not in the repository or DECODE; printed Swedish editions not searched).

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout obtained the samples from the archive and read the blind sign sheet; Claude transcribed the key and the letter, decoded and read.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: 14 sample views of Pommeranica vol. 149 supplied by the Riksarkivet (J. Mispelaere); images private, none committed.
Key of the time found on views 143346 (joined form) and 143443 (isolated form) of the same volume; transcribed as shape codes and frozen by SHA-256 before decoding.
Letter 143535, both cipher blocks (326 cipher letters), as shape codes; not blind (declared).

Blind sign sheet 2411 (sign_check/): Brice Dudout chose the shape seen for 11 doubtful signs (3 controls, 3/3; rule hashed before the thumbnails, SHA-256 c88aedfe...). The double loop splits into k (two loops side by side), m (small then large loop) and l (large then small); g and t confirmed; a slanting H gets no value. Sure words 41 -> 47 of 68.
Letter 143535: 68 cipher words, 47 sure, 5 probable, 3 restored, 13 unresolved (reading.md); continuous German on the Muscovite deserters sent to Sweden or put into the regiments.
Repository catalogue (entry 451, open), research/leads.json, targets/ and DECODE: no decipherment. Printed Swedish editions not searched.

outcome.method_basis: Key of the time on views 143346 and 143443 of the same volume.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md: 47 sure of 68 cipher words of letter 143535 (sure words only); with probable and restored words 55/68 = 0.81

gaps.detail: ink blots at L1-L2, L4, L8 and in block 2; segmentation of joined signs uncertain in L3 (wengen, lehgen) and block 2 line 11
seen among the samples; 143523 line 1 decoded only, 143510 not transcribed (a more cursive hand)

gaps.item: printed editions and the year of 143535
gaps.detail: Historiska handlingar and Karl XII's letters not searched; 1712 or 1714 not settled by the text read

outcome.notes: Images: Riksarkivet, Pommeranica vol. 149, samples supplied by the archive (J. Mispelaere), 24 Nov 2026; no reuse licence asked or given, none committed. AI analysis was not raised with the archive; the project's method was not presented to it at the time. No held-out validation: a key of the time with no gloss to test against; block 1 (272 letters) is under the 300-letter portion.

sign_check.rule: sign_check/sheet-2411-rule.md (24 Nov 2026, before the thumbnails and the answers)
sign_check.sheet_faults: one key example (the joined m of 143346) is struck through on the key sheet, noticed by the reader at q02
sign_check.note: Letter 143535 (and one sign each of 143523 and 143510), images private. k / m / l: the double loop splits into DK = k, DM = m (a form not offered, described by the reader), LH = l; g and t confirmed; a slanting H (HP) gets no value. Sure words 41 -> 47 of 68 for 143535. Not a human_check: AI agents built and scored the sheet.

texts.label: Meyerfeldt to the King, "d. 15 Januarij" (1712 or 1714), Pommeranica vol. 149, view 143535
texts.summary: The Muscovite deserters, very few: some have been sent to Sweden, the others distributed among the regiments so that they do not eat the bread uselessly, until they can be sent safely to Sweden; then, in clear, letters from Stralsund from Major General Mevius.

reading_review.note: Key of the time; one reader for the transcription (not blind) and a blind sign sheet by Brice Dudout for the doubtful forms; read in part, 47 of 68 cipher words sure.
